buy.name: Long put
why: Regime read is HOLD (+0) → partly fits this bear structure (weight capped at 20 — the regime read has a weak track record).
IV30 ÷ realised vol = 0.90 → options look cheap vs how the stock has actually moved; this structure is net long volatility (helps).

Model edge: if volatility ends up halfway between the market's 103% and the stock's recent realised 125% (= 114%), the expected profit of this trade is −$19 per contract (-10% of max risk), assuming zero price drift.
Probability of profit 40% on market-implied vol, 44% at realised vol.
Spot is below the gamma flip: dealer hedging tends to amplify moves, which suits owning premium.
flags: Wide bid/ask on at least one leg (29% of mid) — expect to pay more than the mid price.
